'''Lurking Doom''' was an [[Esh-kha]] who was imprisoned by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], only to be released during the [[Galactic War]]. Lurking Doom was a servant of the [[World Razer]].

==Behind the scenes==
Lurking Doom was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where the Esh-kha sends Republic players a message if they made a deal with the World Razer.
